# VIZRA — AI Creative Studio & Omnia 1.0

> VIZRA (`https://vizra.vercel.app/`) is an AI creative studio and multimodal workflow workspace powered by Omnia 1.0. It unites conversational reasoning, grounded web search, code and WebGL shader synthesis, design systems, visual synthesis, audio composition, and persistent 10-stage project workflows in one web platform.

## Canonical Entry Points

- [Home — VIZRA AI Creative Studio](https://vizra.vercel.app/): Overview of VIZRA, Omnia 1.0 preview, platform architecture, and studio entry points.
- [Features & Pipeline](https://vizra.vercel.app/features): 4 Core Pillars (Think, Create, Build, Explore), 5-Step Idea-to-Finish pipeline, and 10-stage persistent project memory.
- [AI Tools & Create Hub](https://vizra.vercel.app/tools): 8 specialized creative disciplines covering writing, design tokens, visual canvas, React/TypeScript/GLSL code, presentations, grounded web research, multimodal file audit, and staged video synthesis.
- [Creative Studio & R&D Roadmap](https://vizra.vercel.app/studio): 4 studio engines (Temporal Motion Synthesis, Omnia Neural Direction, Procedural Shader Synthesis, Kinetic Spatial Typography) and 6 future R&D concept prototypes.
- [Explore 3D Creative Showcase](https://vizra.vercel.app/explore): Interactive 3D perspective showcase tunnel and starter prompt remix profiles across 6 creative disciplines.
- [Pricing & Compute Tiers](https://vizra.vercel.app/pricing): Creator Free ($0), Omnia Pro ($19/mo billed annually or $24/mo monthly), and VIZRA Studio & Team ($64/mo billed annually or $79/mo monthly), plus billing FAQs.
- [Public Documentation Centre (A–H)](https://vizra.vercel.app/docs): Complete A–Z documentation (Sections A–H, 49 reference topics and 17 feature guides) covering Omnia 1.0, 10-stage workflows, live vs. staged availability, privacy & security, and troubleshooting.
- [VIZRA Editorial Blog](https://vizra.vercel.app/blog): 20 published, fact-checked technical monographs across Batch 1 (AI Foundations, Articles 01–10) and Batch 2 (Machine Learning & Advanced AI, Articles 11–20), featuring KaTeX mathematics, technical architecture diagrams, comparison tables, FAQs, and primary verified references.
- [About VIZRA & Core Creed](https://vizra.vercel.app/about): Mission ("Don't just ask AI. Work with it."), response proportionality, zero fabricated citations, and studio philosophy.
- [Contact & Studio Inquiries](https://vizra.vercel.app/contact): Enterprise studio onboarding, technical support, partnerships, and early-access beta requests.

## Solutions, Comparisons & Free Tools

- [Free AI Prompt Optimizer](https://vizra.vercel.app/free-ai-prompt-optimizer): Zero-signup browser tool structuring creative prompts across 7 disciplines (motion design, art direction, GLSL/WebGL code, storyboards, brand systems, grounded research, and Lyria 3 music) with a 6-point structural rubric audit and one-click Omnia 1.0 launch.
- [AI Creative Studio](https://vizra.vercel.app/ai-creative-studio): End-to-end overview of VIZRA's browser studio uniting Omnia 1.0, code/shaders, visual synthesis, WAV audio, and 10-stage workflows.
- [AI Workspace for Creators](https://vizra.vercel.app/ai-workspace-for-creators): Persistent 10-stage project tracking, 5-file brief auditing, and 25 MB local RAG explorer.
- [AI Tools for Motion Designers](https://vizra.vercel.app/ai-tools-for-motion-designers): GLSL/WebGL shader prototyping, storyboarding, and WAV scratch soundtracks (with transparent disclosure that Temporal Video is in staging).
- [AI Assistant for Creative Work](https://vizra.vercel.app/ai-assistant-for-creative-work): Omnia 1.0 adaptive reasoning modes, live verified HTTPS citations, and English/Hindi/Hinglish fluency.
- [Platform Alternatives & Comparisons](https://vizra.vercel.app/alternatives): Honest, verification-dated comparisons against [Canva](https://vizra.vercel.app/vizra-vs-canva), [Runway](https://vizra.vercel.app/vizra-vs-runway), [Krea AI](https://vizra.vercel.app/vizra-vs-krea-ai), and Adobe Express.

## Policy & Governance

- [Privacy Policy](https://vizra.vercel.app/privacy-policy): Minimal data collection, user-isolated cloud storage, consent records, self-service account deletion (`DELETE /api/account/data`), and subprocessors.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://vizra.vercel.app/terms-and-conditions): VIZRA Age Assurance & Parental Consent Framework (Omnia Adult & Omnia Youth), acceptable use, AI copyrightability notice (no guaranteed copyright or universal exclusive ownership), DMCA procedure, and EU AI Act Article 50(2) provenance disclosures.
- [Cookie & Storage Policy](https://vizra.vercel.app/cookie-policy): Default-off optional categories (`Analytics`, `Functional`, `Marketing`), cookieless Vercel Web Analytics separation, and storage inventory.

## Extended AI Reference

- [Full Structured Reference (/llms-full.txt)](https://vizra.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete factual specification of Omnia 1.0 capabilities, live vs. staging availability, workspace boundaries, safety posture, and non-indexed routes.
- [Live Capability Registry (`/api/capabilities`)](https://vizra.vercel.app/api/capabilities): Machine-readable NO POWERS capability registry listing LIVE, STAGED, UNAVAILABLE, and RESTRICTED capabilities.

## Key Factual Boundaries

- **Age Assurance & Parental Consent Framework**: VIZRA supports **Omnia Adult** (18+) and **Omnia Youth** (eligible minors under 18 with jurisdiction-compliant verifiable parental consent via `/parental-consent` and strict fail-closed verification). Live Voice, unrestricted audio synthesis, paid upgrades, external connectors, behavioral age inference, and targeted advertising are disabled for Youth accounts even with consent. Child conversations are not automatically exposed to parents.
- **Live vs. Staging Status**: Conversational reasoning, grounded Google Search citations, React/TypeScript/GLSL code synthesis, Science Hub queries (AlphaFold DB, PubChem, PubMed), AI Music Studio (5–120s instrumental WAV audio, Adult only), and authenticated Live Voice Mode (Adult only) are live inside the web studio. Temporal Video & Scene Synthesis (`STAGED`) and third-party external OAuth connectors (Google Drive/Docs/Sheets, GitHub, Figma, Canva, YouTube, Notion, Dropbox) are disclosed in the UI, `/api/capabilities`, and docs as `STAGED` / `UNAVAILABLE` pending external approval.
- **Web-First Studio Delivery**: Interactive studio capabilities operate inside the VIZRA web workspace (`/ai` and `/workspace`).
- **Non-Indexed Private Routes**: `/ai`, `/history`, `/settings`, `/parental-consent`, `/workspace`, `/seo-diagnostics`, `/live`, and `/api/*` are user-specific, authenticated, or operational routes marked `noindex, nofollow` and excluded from crawling.
